name: Hossein Mohammaddokht
introduction: I've spent most of my career working with Linux, networking, servers, and production systems. In recent years, my work has focused on DevOps, Kubernetes, API gateways, API management, and troubleshooting financial applications.
direction: I'm now building my own software products, moving toward AI Systems & Platform Engineering and infrastructure for AI agents. I work across development and operations, often tracing issues from the application down to the infrastructure.

experience.title: Independent Product & Platform Engineer
experience.summary: Working on AgentWallet, Atlas, and Kuhban, alongside their supporting infrastructure.
bullets: Working on three independent products with a focus on backend services, infrastructure, API design, testing, and deployment.
Setting up and maintaining Docker-based environments, databases, CI/CD workflows, and supporting services.
Working toward practical AI and agent-based features in these products.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer (API Platforms)
experience.summary: API gateways, API management, Kubernetes, and troubleshooting financial applications.
bullets: Worked mainly on API gateway and API management systems: deployment, configuration, API policies, integration issues, and day-to-day troubleshooting.
Maintained API management services on Kubernetes and investigated issues between applications, gateways, and backend services.
Supported financial applications, including Apache Fineract, and troubleshot Java-based services and integration problems.
Tested application behavior, checked logs and API responses, and worked with developers to find and fix issues.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
experience.summary: Linux infrastructure, reverse proxies, deployments, and application architecture.
bullets: Moved parts of the infrastructure from Windows/IIS to Linux-based environments.
Configured and maintained reverse proxies, mainly Nginx and Traefik, for application routing and access.
Helped move applications from a monolithic setup toward microservices and supported the launch of the Mobedu e-commerce platform.
Worked on Linux servers, troubleshooting, application deployments, and system reliability.

experience.title: Freelance Network & Data Center Engineer
experience.summary: Network infrastructure, servers, virtualization, and firewalls for small businesses.
bullets: Built and maintained networks, servers, virtualization environments, and firewall configurations for small businesses.
Helped clients troubleshoot infrastructure and connectivity problems.

experience.title: Project Manager & Network Engineer
experience.summary: Data center and network infrastructure operations.
bullets: Maintained data center servers and network infrastructure, including monitoring and security tools.
Worked on network security, system availability, and Linux/Windows environments.

experience.title: Technical Engineer & Help Desk
bullets: Provided technical support, network troubleshooting, and IT systems maintenance across multiple companies.

projects.name: AgentWallet
projects.title: AI Agent Authorization & Transaction Platform
projects.short: Permissioned actions and traceable transactions for AI agents.
projects.description: A platform where AI agents can request services and prepare actions on behalf of users, with clear permission limits and confirmation for sensitive steps.
bullets: Working on agent and user authorization, permissions, and controlled workflows.
Exploring test wallet balances, orders, receipts, and auditable transactions in a development environment.
Not presented as a live financial service.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.title: Regional Intelligence & Tourism Platform
projects.short: Geographic and tourism data, with planned AI-assisted discovery.
projects.description: A location-based platform bringing geographic and tourism data together for discovery, research, and tour-guide workflows.
bullets: Working on source-aware data integration, review tools, APIs, and map-based exploration.
Planning AI-assisted search and itinerary features while keeping reviewed geographic data separate from generated suggestions.

projects.name: Kuhban
projects.title: Outdoor Route & Decision-Support Platform
projects.short: Evidence-backed route information and outdoor decision support.
projects.description: A route discovery and information platform that uses geographic data and supporting evidence to help people evaluate outdoor routes.
bullets: Working on data processing, APIs, route management, mobile/admin flows, and deployment infrastructure.
AI-assisted analysis is part of the product direction; route decisions remain with the user.

training: PMP / Agile / Scrum coursework — University of Tehran (2017)
